verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to work with the Stripe API and search Stripe's docs (docs-18, probe-4), and Financial Connections is part of that API. However, nothing shows the MCP toolset covers Financial Connections objects such as sessions, accounts, balances, ownership, or transactions. The agent-oriented Financial Connections use case points to the Link CLI rather than MCP (docs-11). Missing for 10: evidence of Financial Connections-specific MCP tools, documentation of an agent linking accounts or reading account data via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
